facts.fact: 她拿头去撞墙试了试，撞实了是砖墙，确认自己确实被关在砖砌的牢里。
facts.anchor: Kiamling whacked her head against the wall. Yup, solid brick.

facts.fact: 同牢的 Hoi 躺在地上，让她这一下撞得再狠些，好让大家一块儿解脱。
facts.anchor: “Do it harder this time, put us all out of our misery,” Hoi gor said from his position on the floor.

facts.fact: 梁工（foreman）的尸身被拖到墙角，有人用染血的布单给他盖住了脸。
facts.anchor: At least one of them had been courteous enough to cover the foreman’s face with the bloody sheet.

facts.fact: 她由此断定那道裂口根本不在岛上，之前的猜测都错了。
facts.anchor: So the rift was not on the island after all.

facts.fact: 她悟到真正的门户是这座海港本身，不是某间屋子或某个祭坛。
facts.anchor: The harbour was the gateway.

facts.fact: 祖母声音沙哑地问她：没靠帮忙，她一个人推出了多少。
facts.anchor: “So, how much did you figure out without my help?”

facts.fact: 她说伦敦有暗中的势力在牵线，想跟北京开战。
facts.anchor: Secret forces pulling strings in London want to start a war with Peking.

facts.fact: 他们挑上祖母、吴律师、游夫人、梁工，是因为这些人在全岛布了护法。
facts.anchor: because you put protections across the island to prevent them opening gateways

facts.fact: 她回想 Lancaster 撞进死人堆那一幕，明白他是在探祖母的本事有多大。
facts.anchor: Spying on Por Por to discover the extent of her abilities.

facts.fact: 祖母说门已经关不及了，她离开得太久，护法已经失效。
facts.anchor: “It’s too late to close the gateway. I’ve been gone too long.

facts.fact: 她指出阿妈正是死于她和阿爸以为能驭使的那些妖物。
facts.anchor: “She was attacked by the very yiugwai she and Ah Ba thought they could control.

facts.fact: 祖母纠正死者的数目不是成百，是数千。
facts.anchor: “Thousands…” Por Por corrected, almost absent-mindedly.

facts.fact: 她说赔多少钱也换不回死人，祖母只回一句「补偿」。
facts.anchor: “But the dead remain dead. No amount of money will change that.”

facts.fact: 她说自己已经明白：看着像恶的东西未必真是恶。
facts.anchor: not all that appears evil is truly evil

facts.fact: 她的主张仍是把门关上，不受门后那股火引诱。
facts.anchor: The best course of action is still to close it, not be tempted by the flames.

facts.fact: 祖母说她是几代里最强的猎妖人，弱点是把力气当成了权力。
facts.anchor: Your weakness is that you did not understand that power is about more than who can punch hardest.

facts.fact: 她问 Hoi 的船还在不在港里，他答船名是 Arrow，还在。
facts.anchor: “The Arrow? Yes.”

facts.fact: 妹妹送来的番薯里有一个掺了砒霜，是替狱卒备下的。
facts.anchor: “That’s one of the ones I laced with arsenic.”

facts.fact: 祖母想起这片地底下埋的是什么：当年清坟留下的尸骨。
facts.anchor: “Corpses.”

facts.fact: 土里升起白色碎骨，小得拼不成一副骨架，却已堆成一个个小堆。
facts.anchor: White fragments, too small to make a complete skeleton, but handfuls of them now, rising into small heaps.

facts.fact: 鬼魂讲价，要八个橘子，还要一人一顶纸轿。
facts.anchor: “Add eight oranges and a paper sedan chair each.”

facts.fact: 骨片打穿砖墙，整面后墙塌了下来。
facts.anchor: the whole back wall came tumbling down

facts.fact: 她只回头看了一眼，就穿过后墙走进夜里。
facts.anchor: Kiamling looked back only once before stepping through the back wall and into the night.
